statement: The price of J-lemma-eight-is-the-exponent-valuation is exactly one logarithm, and it is fatal. Collatz pays 2^(-k) in the density of the locus where the 2-adic constraint bites, the Juggler pays 2^(-k) in the EXPONENT of that density: #{2 <= n <= N : exactRun(n) >= k} = floor(N^(2^-k)) - 1 against #{x <= N : run(x) >= k} = floor((N+1)/2^k) for k >= 1. Exact at every row to N = 10^6, where the Juggler counts are 999999, 999, 30, 4, 1, 0 for k = 0..5 against Collatz's 1000000, 500000, 250000, 125000, 62500, 31250. So the locus where the 2-adic place still acts on the Juggler has density zero for every k >= 1. AND IT IS EMPTY OF INFORMATION BESIDES. An exact run is monochrome, so the depth-k locus carries the two words O^k and E^k, while Collatz's residue system mod 2^k carries all 2^k (Terras 1976, re-run here for d = 1..8 rather than quoted). The honest form of 'the exponential removes the 2-adic rigidity' is that it turns a bijection onto 2^k words into a constant map onto two. THE HAND-OVER IS NAMED. The valuation runs out at the first odd exponent and the first inexact image is floor(m^N sqrt m); on the powers of two, n = 2^e with e odd, that is floor(2^((e-1)/2) sqrt 2), whose parity is the ((e-1)/2)-th binary digit of sqrt 2 -- checked on 201 odd exponents to 401. The 2-adic fibre hands the itinerary to an Archimedean digit of a quadratic irrational, with no congruence available at the seam. A placement, not a transfer: the Mahler cluster's refusal stands and nothing here bears on {(3/2)^n}. THE FIBRE STATED WITHOUT LIMITS. On a prime power the exponent IS a valuation: n = p^e has v_p(n) = e, and the Juggler sends v_p to 3 v_p / 2 on an odd prime and to v_p / 2 at p = 2, where Collatz sends the value u = x + 1 to 3u/2 and v_2(x) to v_2(x) - 1. The Juggler does to valuations what Collatz does to values. CONSEQUENCE. The pointwise odd-run bound for INEXACT runs -- the odd-tower fragment -- cannot be reached from the 2-adic side, because off the perfect powers there is no exponent at all and the conjugacy that produced one does not extend: |2^y - 2^z|_2 = 2^(-min(y,z)) depends on the Archimedean size of the exponents and not on y - z in the 2-adic metric, so y -> 2^y is not uniformly continuous for that metric. The door stays Archimedean, and that is now a reason rather than an observation.

Hercher's Lemma 8 survives the exponential conjugacy, on the exponent, and the laboratory had already proved it under another name. Conjugating the Collatz odd step by u = x + 1 turns (3x+1)/2 into exactly u -> 3u/2; the Juggler's exact odd step on n = a^e turns, on the exponent, into exactly e -> 3e/2. Same map, same prime, same reason -- 3 is a 2-adic unit, so one step costs exactly one unit of v_2 and nothing else -- and the exact even step e -> e/2 costs the same unit, so the valuation drops by one per step whatever the letter and an exact run is monochrome, the letter being the parity of the base. COLLATZ CARRIES THE 2-ADIC INTEGER IN THE VALUE, THE JUGGLER IN THE EXPONENT. Hence one law at the two ends of x = 2^y: run(x) = v_2(x+1) (Hercher 2023, Lemma 8: k consecutive odd steps force x = -1 mod 2^k) and exactRun(n) = v_2(e(n)), where e(n) = max{e : n = a^e} and exactRun counts consecutive states at which the floor is not charged, that is consecutive squares. The Juggler half is kernel-checked as HasPowTwoDepth with hasPowTwoDepth_even_exact, hasPowTwoDepth_odd_exact and power_bound_eq_implies_pow_two_depth (j-saturation-budget, filed as a local arithmetic question in August); the converse half is isSquare_pow_three_iff. Exhaustive agreement to N = 10^6: 999 square states, 19859 non-square states, 100000 odd Collatz starts, no failure. THE FLOOR IS THE EXPONENTIAL OF THE FLOOR. Both pointwise bounds follow by the same product-formula step -- a nonzero integer with v_2 >= k has absolute value at least 2^k -- and both are attained: run(x) >= k forces x >= 2^k - 1, attained at 2^k - 1; exactRun(n) >= k forces n >= 2^(2^k), and on odd starts n >= 3^(2^k), attained at 3^(2^k) with word O^k. log(3^(2^k)) = 2^k log 3, so J-juggler-is-collatz-one-exponential-up holds pointwise and not only on the walk. WHAT IT DOES NOT DO, WHICH IS THE POINT. Hercher's hypothesis is k consecutive odd LETTERS, a condition on the word that any cycle with a long run supplies free; the mirror's hypothesis is k consecutive EXACT steps, a condition on the integer that no word implies. The exponential moves the hypothesis from the word to the arithmetic, so the mirror is inert for cycles and for termination: no floor is raised, no m-cycle is excluded, and no Collatz bound is improved. Lemma 8 is quoted from hercher-2023-collatz-m-cycles, not reproved. PRIORITY CORRECTION, 20 SEPTEMBER: THE COLLATZ HALF IS WILLIAMS 2026. williams-2026-collatz-coordinates (arXiv:2607.01718, compiled 3 July 2026) builds Collatz dynamics on exactly the coordinate this row opens with. Every odd n has a unique n + 1 = lambda 2^a 3^b with gcd(lambda,6) = 1 and a >= 1, and her (lambda, a, b) is precisely (the 6-free part of x+1, v_2(x+1), v_3(x+1)); her Theorem 3.6 and Proposition 3.11 are the diagonal flow (a,b) -> (a-1,b+1) multiplying n+1 by exactly 3/2, which IS the statement that u = x + 1 conjugates the odd shortcut step to u -> 3u/2. Her Corollary 3.9 is the run length a - 1 to the boundary, Lemma 8 in coordinates; her Corollary 3.7 is v_2(3n+1) = 1 in the interior; her preserved row index k = a + b is the first integral v_2 + v_3; and her preserved lambda is the conserved 6-free part. Verified here against her definitions on odd n < 2e5. So the Collatz side of this row is NOT NEW and is hers, and the laboratory reached it independently two and a half months later. WHAT STANDS is the half this row exists for: her paper is pure Collatz, with no Juggler and no floor-power map, so exactRun(n) = v_2(e(n)), the identification with the kernel-checked HasPowTwoDepth, the attained floors n >= 2^(2^k) and 3^(2^k), the monochrome fibre and the density contrast floor(N^(2^-k)) - 1 against floor((N+1)/2^k) are the laboratory's. Her Section 1.3.3 also records the 3/2 flow's Flatto and Mahler links as structural rather than a tool, with leverage an open question -- the laboratory's own position, reached independently.
